thought.text: Admin login and dashboard work. Now verifying a few public pages and the role user login, plus a quick test-env sanity check:

reasoning_content:
The dashboard route doesn't exist — that's just a routing 404, no problem (maybe the dashboard route is different). /admin, /admin/projekts, /admin/users, /admin/settings all return 200. The admin login is fully functional.

Let's also quickly test logging in as the moderator role, and additionally check a few public pages. Also, I'll check the admin user list page to confirm that seeded users are displayed, and check the admin project (projekt) page too.

Next, let's verify that the test environment works. The guide says to run the tests with `bin/rspec`. The summary noted pre-existing failures in the spec (factory/model mismatches). Let's run a quick rspec subset to see the overall state — a full run of `bin/rspec` could take a very long time. To check the state of the test infrastructure, let's run just one fast spec file. According to the summary, spec/models/signature_spec.rb → 26 examples, 19 failures (pre-existing issue). Let's verify with a small spec.

Also verify production assets and RAILS_ENV=production boot (temporary). And check whether the development server has been running stably (started at 20:07, still responding).

Let's also confirm that the /admin page loads the user list (200 response already confirmed). It might be worth grepping the title to confirm there's no exception.

action.command: cd /tmp && for p in / /users/sign_in /api/v1/health 2>/dev/null; do :; done; for p in / /projekts /debates /proposals /budget; do echo -n "$p: "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000$p; done; echo "=== mod login test ==="; rm -f cj4.txt; TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj4.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in | grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj4.txt -c cj4.txt -o /dev/null -w "mod POST: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[login]=mod@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"
